description_zh:
这是一款第一人称射击小游戏，你需要在堡垒地图里搜集补给、击杀 5 名敌军完成突围，最后根据击杀、命中率和用时获得得分评价。

【操作】WASD 移动 · 鼠标瞄准 · 左键开火 · R 换弹 · E 拾取/使用物品 · Q 切换枪械

【核心机制】目标为击败 5 名敌军（进度 0/5），同时搜集地图补给。生命值初始 100%，护甲需拾取补给获得；手枪弹药无限，其他武器有弹容量限制。对局带作战计时，结束后统计击杀数、命中率、用时与总得分并给出评价，可输入玩家名字查看排行榜、支持再来一局。

【设置与暂停】暂停菜单可继续或重开本局；设置可开关音乐与音效、调整视角灵敏度、反转垂直视角、调整画质、开关镜头震动。

作者表示后续还会更新。
description_en:
A first-person shooter mini-game: gather supplies inside a fortress map, take down 5 enemies to break out, and receive a score rating based on kills, accuracy, and time.

[Controls] WASD to move · mouse to aim · left click to fire · R to reload · E to pick up/use items · Q to switch weapons

[Core mechanics] Defeat 5 enemies (progress 0/5) while collecting supplies across the map. Health starts at 100%; armor must be picked up as a supply. The pistol has unlimited ammo, while other weapons have magazine limits. Each run is timed, and at the end your kills, accuracy, time, and total score are tallied into a rating. Enter your name to view the leaderboard and replay instantly.

[Settings & Pause] The pause menu lets you resume or restart the run; settings toggle music and sound effects, adjust look sensitivity, invert vertical look, change graphics quality, and toggle camera shake.

The developer notes that more updates are planned.
